contexts.text: Sarai was barren, she had no offspring = that what is evil and false produced itself no more.
A son and daughter signify truth and good, and in the opposite sense, evil and falsity; hence barren = that the evil and falsity of idolatrous worship produced themselves no more.
Barrenness, namely, of doctrine, Signified. This is evident from the signification of shutting the womb, which is, to hinder conception itself...
(Rebecca) barren = that there was no Divine Natural yet. Explained.
Rachel was barren = that interior truths were not received... Barren = that there were thence no doctrines, and thus no Churches either.
Such a rite (of another's bringing forth upon the knees of the wife) was received when the wife was barren, lest she should represent the dead who do not rise again to life.
Before (man is being regenerated) the good of love and the truth of faith fall like seed into ground that is utterly barren.
Barren = that which is devoid of truths and goods.
Under Abort, see this reference. AC 9325:4.

There shall not be an unfruitful and barren one () = not devoid of life from truth and good, thus that they shall be spiritually alive. As barrenness has this signification, the women in the Ancient Churches accounted themselves not to be alive when they were barren; as for instance, Rachel, who said to Jacob... Give me sons, and if not I am dead.

By the barren are also signified those who are not in good because they are not in truths, but still earnestly desire truths in order to be in good, as do the upright gentiles... As in Isaiah; Sing, barren, that didst not bear, break forth into singing and shout for joy she who hath not brought forth, for many are the sons of the desolate above the sons of the married (). (Further Illustrated.) In these places, by the barren ones are meant the nations who are summoned to the Church, and to whom the Church is transferred, when the old one ceases to be.
The land barren () = the good of the Church not alive. (Its cure.) Signified, Explained.
The subject here treated of, is the Church to be established among the gentiles, which is called the barren that has not borne, from being without truths from the Word.
The barren () = him who before was not in the truths and goods of the Church. AE 223:16. AE 717:5. AE 721:5.
Unless there be delight also, good is barren...
Until the barren has borne seven ()... The barren = the Church from the gentiles, who had not the Word. AR 535:2.
Without life from (delights), goods and truths are as it were inanimate, and are also barren.
The barren bearing seven = those who are outside the Church, and do not know truths, because they have not the Word; thus the gentiles, to whom will be given all things.
By the barren, and the wombs which have not borne () are signified those who have not received genuine truths, that is, truths from the good of love.
(The gentiles) are called barren because they have not known the Lord, nor had the Word, wherein are truths, and therefore could not be regenerated.
A barren house () = where there was no marriage of truth and good.
